title: Print the workout length
prompt: `Workout` has two shapes. A planned workout has a `title`. A done workout has `minutes`. The starter handles planned workouts. Complete `describe` so a done workout gives `"Minutes: "` followed by its minutes, including 0. Keep `"Next: "` followed by the title for planned workouts, even an empty title.
hints: After the early `return`, which shape is left?
Look at the field that goes with the `"done"` tag.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Prints the same 0 for every done workout.
Reads `title` before checking which shape arrived.

feedback: After the early `return`, which shape is left?
